description: Rail IFC Quality Gate—Anonymized derived outputs dataset (Depot_A/Depot_B) (v1.0.4) From IFC validation to publish/hold decisions: A tool-independent quality-gating framework for railway depots is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors JUAN A. GARCÍA, IGNACION TOLEDO (Alicante University). This dataset provides non-sensitive, anonymized derived outputs from an IFC quality audit and gating workflow applied to rail depot deliverables. It is designed to enable exact replication of all tables and figures reported in the associated manuscript without sharing the underlying confidential IFC files or owner contractual requirement documents. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
